findings.title: Sleep in test with no async work to wait on
findings.note: Load() is synchronous file I/O with no goroutines or timers to wait on, so the 10ms sleep serves no synchronization purpose and only adds arbitrary latency/flakiness risk to the suite.

findings.title: TestLoadSmoke discards result and asserts nothing
findings.note: Result of Load is discarded with no assertion on its value; since path "x" does not exist, Load returns nil via the early ReadFile-error branch, so the test never exercises the JSON-unmarshal path it appears to target.

looks_bad_but_fine.why: if _, err := Open("missing"); err == nil { t.Fatal(...) } is the standard idiomatic Go pattern for asserting an error occurred (no assert library available); it is a single deterministic check, not conditional logic branching test behavior on data.
